title: Unit – 5 : Session – 6 : SLO – 1  |  Symbolic Calculus — Differentiation and Integration
sections: 1. Differentiate x³ — d/dx(x³) = 3x². In SymPy: diff(x**3, x) → 3*x**2.
2. Integrate 2x — ∫ 2x dx = x² + C. In SymPy: integrate(2*x, x) → x**2 (constant omitted).
3. Differentiate sin(x) — d/dx sin(x) = cos(x). In SymPy: diff(sin(x), x) → cos(x).
from sympy import symbols, diff, integrate, sin
